notes.title: 1.0 Update
notes.notes: Unyielding will leave Early Access  on 9/21.  Almost there!

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
3 years ago, I released the first version of Unyielding, and boy was it a mess.  We've come a long way since then.  Unyielding has finally reached the point where their honestly isn't much programming work to do.  The game has crystalized, and we march towards completion.  It's a good place to be!

I'm hoping to finish Unyielding this year.  I'm going to try really hard!  We have to finish Sandy, the fallout of that, the personal story lines (Daud, Liz, Willem, Danica) and then do the ending event.  It's so much writing!  

So...what's next?  I will be doing another game obviously.  What that game is isn't clear exactly yet.  If you spy on my stream, you can see me working on "The Pill Game" sometimes, but that is just a combat system.  I haven't put thought into the story or characters yet.  I'm not allowed to think about it's story until Unyielding is done!  I'm hoping The Pill Game has a much smoother launch than Unyielding did.  

Here is to another year!  I don't know what will happen during it, but I hope to continue making fun content.
